content.title: Nokia Stock Soars. Nvidia to Invest $1 Billion and Take 2.9% Stake.
content.summary: Nvidia  will invest $1 billion in  Nokia  in a deal to boost the Finnish company’s ability to build connectivity technology for artificial intelligence.  Nokia  will issue  Nvidia  more than 166 million shares at $6.01 apiece, giving  Nvidia  a 2.9% ownership stake in the company.  Nokia intends to develop its radio access network software to run on Nvidia’s chips.
